correctness.rationale: PASS: For every integer n>=2 the source Algorithm 3 specializes exactly to independently sampled uniform increasing parents with conductance (n-i)/n, yielding a rooted weighted tree and E[T]=P. Backward induction over added pendant vertices proves E[R_T(a,b)]=n for every distinct pair; double-centering the resistance matrix proves E[T^dagger]=(n/2)P. The mandatory last edge has resistance n deterministically, giving lambda_min(T|1^perp)<=2/n. Quantifiers, positive edge weights, nullspaces, normalization and the star-center elimination order were checked against arXiv:2011.07769 and arXiv:2303.00709. The package verifier exhaustively enumerated 5,913 weighted trees for 2<=n<=8 using exact fractions. Enumeration supplements but does not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: PASS: This is a complete infinite-family inverse-sensitivity law of an actual published approximate-Cholesky elimination primitive. It proves an exact n/2 pseudoinverse inflation in every centered direction despite E[T]=P and connectedness, and a deterministic tiny-eigenvalue witness for every sampled tree. Effective resistance is a natural electrical/numerical invariant central to Laplacian solution quality; its exact degree dependence motivates alternatives with more edges or different distributions. Neither a routine finite table nor unsupported conjectured downstream speedup. Its scope is explicitly local and does not infer whole-solver performance.
